title: Code for: Self-generated facial affect prototypes are reliable but largely independent of trait empathy
description: Genetic-algorithm face task (MATLAB/Psychtoolbox-3) and Python analysis code for Cui & Bex, "Self-generated facial affect prototypes are reliable but largely independent of trait empathy" (manuscript under review). Computes every statistic and figure reported in the paper. Participant data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
notes: Supported by the National Eye Institute of the National Institutes of Health under Award Number R01EY032162.
